# Donald Trump indictments, 2023-2025
Across these four indictments, Trump was charged with a total of 88 criminal counts. As of July 15, 2026, he had been found guilty of 34 criminal counts, and 52 charges were dismissed.

On May 30, 2024, former President [Donald Trump](https://ballotpedia.org/Donald_Trump) (R) was convicted of 34 counts of falsifying business records in the first degree.

In June 2023, Trump was indicted on 37 federal criminal charges related to his handling of classified government documents.

## Overview
As of July 15, 2026, he had been found guilty of 34 criminal counts and 52 charges were dismissed.

| Case | Counts | Total charges | Plea | Verdicts |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| **Counts 1-34**: Falsifying business records in the first degree |  |  | 34 | Not guilty | Guilty of 34 counts |

## Federal indictment (classified documents case)
A federal grand jury charged Former President [Donald Trump](https://ballotpedia.org/Donald_Trump) (R) with 40 criminal counts related to his handling of classified documents in June and July 2023.
